summary: Tested new AI Analyst SSE endpoints and reset-all flow (backend + frontend). Backend 6/6 passing (after minor test tweak). Frontend AI streaming + reset-all confirm flow works end-to-end. Found 1 frontend runtime bug: clicking ai-reset while last-stream token is still in-flight (or shortly after) throws TypeError in AiAnalyst and shows a full-page red overlay, blocking further UI use.

ui_bugs.issue: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'content') when tokens arrive after msgs was cleared (e.g. clicking ai-reset just after a stream). setMsgs updater does `c[c.length-1].content + tok` without guarding c.length===0. Result: red uncaught runtime error overlay, ai-suggestion chips do not re-render (count=0), UI is blocked.

action_items: In AiAnalyst.jsx streaming token handler, guard against empty msgs after reset. Suggested fix: `setMsgs((m) => { if (!m.length || m[m.length-1].role !== 'assistant') return m; const c=[...m]; c[c.length-1] = { ...c[c.length-1], content: c[c.length-1].content + tok }; return c; });`  Also consider aborting the fetch reader in reset() (keep an AbortController) so stray tokens after reset are dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: AiAnalyst.reset() does not abort the in-flight fetch/reader; late SSE tokens still mutate state after msgs was cleared, causing the crash.
routes_ai.py:_context() may load up to 20k coupon_claims + 5k redemptions into a single JSON prompt — will scale poorly. Consider aggregating in Mongo instead of client-side.
routes_ai.py stores full assistant message (potentially large) in ai_messages with no size cap.
SSE endpoint does not send any keep-alive between meta and first token; proxies could time out on slower model calls.

Reset-all UI: dialog + input gating + toast + kpi-receita-sistema-value=0 € all work. Only frontend bug is the AiAnalyst reset-race TypeError described above.
rca of the issue: AiAnalyst.jsx line ~38: token handler does `c[c.length-1].content + tok`. reset() clears msgs to [] and clears session, but doesn't abort the still-running fetch reader. Any SSE token frame that arrives after reset (or the trailing token right before `done` after the second answer) executes with c=[], so c[-1] is undefined -> TypeError -> React error boundary overlay. Repro: send AI question, wait for answer, click ai-reset within ~1s. Mitigation: guard in state updater AND AbortController cancelled in reset().
